description: Different model profiles should preserve cycle-safe KMP api export traversal, source-set visibility, and qualified target tasks.

lockedFields.reason: Every supported child contributes its module-qualified JVM target test task.
The complete all-KMP aggregate and its literal source-set api edge are inside the bounded slice.
The untested common formatter remains the only add-test item.
Common and JVM-specific transitively exported sources retain extend-test recommendations.
The transitively exported JVM validator keeps its stable target identity.
The named JVM test source set sees the dependency module's JVM variant through the common api chain.
The JVM validator result is consumed by a kotlin.test assertion.
The uncovered transitively exported formatter remains an add-test item.
The common parser is covered through the intermediate module's commonMain api edge.
Common transitive evidence must preserve its commonTest owner.
